sm: This Louder With Crowder article mocks a protest at Salt Lake City airport, where demonstrators in baggage claim sang a song with altered lyrics calling for an end to ICE deportation flights, greeting Thanksgiving travelers. The writer says the left's anti-ICE demonstrations returned now that the midterms are over, after a stretch focused on data centers. He argues that such performative protests have never changed anyone's mind, especially at an airport, where travelers just want to get to their destination. He jokes that being bothered there would make him less sympathetic, and wonders aloud whether the singers workshop lyrics together or simply follow one person's harmony. He also says he cannot place the original song and asks readers to tell him if they can.
